notes.title: NEXT UPDATE TURN TO PARTICIPATIVE UPDATES
notes.notes: Thank you to all those who have very well received the game and have not hesitated to send me messages of support and asking me to add items to the game. So I decided to fully involve the community in the future developements of the game and I ask you to speak and write in the forum everything you want to see in future updates. I'll try to update the game every 2 weeks and achieve the maximum of requests. Feel free to share and recommend the game to your friends A first update will arrive within a week and then every two weeks. Thank you again for your support.
